title: R1 Neo: Battery ADC telemetry
description: Add battery0 telemetry node for R1 Neo ADC voltage-divider sensor. Currently missing from DTS. Implement and validate lichen_hal_power_snapshot_get() battery_percent and battery_voltage_mv.
close_reason: Already implemented: R1 Neo DTS has battery0 alias (line 56), vbatt voltage-divider node (lines 60-66), and ADC channel@7 (lines 104-111). Board configs enable CONFIG_SENSOR=y and CONFIG_LICHEN_HAS_BATTERY=y. HAL read_voltage_divider_battery() provides battery_voltage_mv. battery_percent is N/A for voltage-dividers (requires fuel gauge). Verified in lichen/boards/muzi/r1_neo/r1_neo_nrf52840.dts and lichen/apps/*/boards/r1_neo_nrf52840.conf.
